entities.summary: Dylan Sikura is a Canadian professional ice hockey centre who currently plays for HC Dynamo Moscow of the Kontinental Hockey League (KHL). He was drafted by the Chicago Blackhawks in the sixth round, 178th overall, in the 2014 NHL Entry Draft. Before turning professional, Sikura played college ice hockey with Northeastern University, where he was named to the AHCA East First-Team All-American and the Hockey East First All-Star team.
